All European destinations

Households, businesses,
military and job transfers.

CODEM handles national moves and moves throughout Europe, with particular experience of France – Italy – Spain – Portugal routes. The team speaks French, Portuguese, Spanish and English, and looks at regular trips or shared loads.

Depending on the package, CODEM can dismantle and pack furniture, artwork, mirrors, chandeliers and fragile items, then load, transport and unpack.

  • Regular departures France – Italy – Spain – Portugal
  • Office, records and IT equipment transfers
  • Storage available while you are away
